items.claim: Kyle Prepolec does not handle pressure well and borderline quit against Drew Dober's relentless pressure.
items.quote: I don't think Prepolec likes pressure. And I went back and watched the the Drew Dober fight and it, you know, after Dober kicked Prepolec in the ball sack and lost a point, Dober just started pressuring him relentlessly and Prepolec was like didn't know what to do.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec has poor takedown defense and makes mistakes on the mat, leading to multiple submission losses.
items.quote: He has like a 50% takedown defense if that. Let's say it's 45% and he's making so many mistakes on the mat. He's giving up his back. He's giving up bad positions. He's been submitted in multiple fights.

items.claim: Mateusz Rębecki is a very good grappler and black belt who can exploit Prepolec's weak grappling defense.
items.quote: Rębecki is a very good grappler. I believe Rębecki is a black belt.

items.claim: Marina Spasic has a kickboxing background but has not faced top-tier competition.
items.quote: she has a kickboxing background. She has fought a lot of bombs though. You know, she has not fought the best competition.
